jobs.title: Remote High-Ticket Closer
jobs.description: Headquarters: Nashville, Tennessee, United States URL: https://6figurecreative.com/podcast/ This position offers $100K guaranteed minimum with uncapped commissions selling a $6,400 business consulting offer to leads who were generated primarily through Meta ads Please do not apply unless you can provide real numbers from your previous sales roles. During the interview process, be prepared to walk us through how many calls you took, how many sales you made, what the offer cost, where the leads came from, how much revenue you personally closed, and exactly how your close rate was calculated. ----- Dear future sales rep, We're searching for someone who is incredible at turning skeptical strangers into clients by truly understanding what is happening in their business, helping them see what needs to change, and guiding them through the fears and objections keeping them stuck. Most of our prospects first discover us through Meta ads. By the time they reach your calendar, they have applied to speak with us and have some familiarity with our company, but most are still cold or lukewarm. You will need to earn their trust. You will need to diagnose the real problem. You will need to help qualified prospects make a clear decision instead of letting them run back to the same habits that have kept their business stuck for years. This role is a top priority at 6 Figure Creative because our entire company exists to help creative freelancers solve one giant problem: They have no idea where their next client is coming from. Everything we do is designed to help them solve that problem permanently by building a repeatable client acquisition system. We're an established, profitable company doing roughly $2.5 million in annual revenue, with a consistent paid acquisition engine generating sales opportunities primarily through Meta ads. We know there is significantly more upside available with the right person in this seat, so we're looking for a proven closer who can help us raise the bar for the entire sales team. Why we are offering a $100K guaranteed minimum Most remote sales jobs throw out a giant OTE number, give you no guarantee whatsoever, and make you absorb all the risk of joining a company you have never worked with before. We are doing something different. We want someone with a real, documented track record who already has other options. We also understand that joining a smaller sales team is a risk. You do not know yet how good our leads are, how strong the offer is, how the company operates, or whether the opportunity is as good as we say it is. So we are taking most of that downside off your plate. You will receive a guaranteed minimum of $100,000 per year while keeping the full upside of our existing uncapped commission structure. To be completely clear, this is not a $100,000 salary plus commissions. Each month, you receive whichever amount is greater: $8,333.33 in guaranteed compensation The commissions you earned that month There is no negative draw balance. You never owe the guarantee back. If your commissions exceed the guarantee, you receive the higher commission amount. The guarantee does not mean the performance standard is lower. It means we are willing to take a real financial risk to attract someone capable of raising it. If you are looking for a comfortable $100,000 job where you can close 15% of your calls and hide, this is not that job. If you perform at the level your track record suggests, the guaranteed minimum should eventually stop mattering because your commissions will be higher. What You'll Do As our Remote High-Ticket Closer, your primary responsibility is converting qualified prospects into clients for our 90-Day Client Acquisition Consulting Sprint. You will conduct consultative enrollment calls over Zoom, diagnose the prospect's business challenges, determine whether they are a strong fit, clearly explain how we can help, and confidently ask qualified prospects to enroll. These are not random cold calls. The prospects have applied to speak with us, but most were originally generated through paid Meta ads and will not arrive fully sold. Once a prospect lands on your calendar, you own that opportunity from preparation through follow-up and final decision. Your main responsibilities include: 1: Enrollment calls: You will spend most of your time helping prospects determine whether our consulting sprint is right for them. If they truly need our help and are a strong fit, you should see it as your responsibility to help them make the decision instead of allowing fear, uncertainty, or a weak objection to send them back to the same situation they wanted to escape. That means you will: Review every application before the call Diagnose the real issues inside the prospect's business Understand their goals, urgency, financial situation, and readiness Determine whether they are a strong fit for our consulting sprint Clearly explain our process, expectations, and investment Make a direct recommendation when you believe they should enroll Handle objections with empathy, patience, and confidence Disqualify prospects who are not a good fit Avoid enrolling obvious red-flag or high-risk clients just to hit a sales number 2: CRM and lead ownership You will take complete ownership of every lead assigned to you inside GoHighLevel. No qualified opportunity should be lost because of weak follow-up, incomplete notes, or an unclear next step. That means you will: Keep every opportunity stage accurate Complete detailed notes after every call Record the outcome and next step for every prospect Complete all required follow-up on time Reschedule qualified prospects who miss their calls Work no-shows through our recovery process Continue following up until the prospect enrolls, declines, or is formally closed out Keep your sales data accurate enough that we never have to guess what is happening inside your pipeline 3: Call review and improvement Every enrollment call is recorded. You should already be excellent at sales when you join us. Call review here is about sharpening strong performance, identifying patterns, testing better approaches, and turning individual wins into improvements the entire sales team can use. You will regularly review your own calls, participate in team call reviews and roleplay, and bring useful insights from your conversations back to the rest of the company. That means you will: Review your own calls and identify specific areas to improve Bring useful wins, losses, and difficult calls to team call reviews Give and receive direct, thoughtful feedback Test new approaches instead of relying on the same script forever Apply what we learn to future calls Help identify patterns in objections, lead quality, messaging, and offer positioning Share what is working so the entire sales team improves alongside you 4: Improve the company's sales process You will work closely with me, the founder, to continuously improve our offer, messaging, scripts, follow-up, and overall sales process. You are talking directly to the market every day. That makes your feedback extremely valuable. You will help us: Identify recurring objections and concerns Find weaknesses in our messaging or offer Improve our enrollment call structure Improve email and text follow-up Reduce the time between the first call and the final decision Share useful insights with our marketing and consulting teams Build a stronger sales system for everyone who joins after you What Success In This Role Looks Like We are hiring someone who can raise the bar, not just hit the current one. Within six months, the expectation is that you are handling approximately 70 to 80 completed sales calls per month and maintaining a 30% or greater close rate. A 35% or greater close rate would be exceptional. We expect a fast ramp: 9 or more new clients in your first full production month 12 or more in your second full production month 15 or more in your third full production month Your first-year target is at least 225 new clients, with 250 or more as the goal. Who you'll work with You will report directly to me (Brian Hood), the founder and person writing this job description. You will also work alongside a veteran closer who has been with the company for 3+ years. We are not a 40-person boiler room where you are handed a script, dropped into a Slack channel, and treated like rep number 37. You will have direct access to the person who can actually change the offer, marketing, script, follow-up process, or sales system when something is not working. See what you'd be selling This role is easier to evaluate when you can see the actual offer and the proof behind it. Review the Clients By Design program overview See what clients have produced from their paid-ad campaigns Why apply for this job? If you're an experienced sales rep who wants to use your skills to help transform the lives of creatives who run freelance businesses, this job might be the perfect fit for you. Our clients include Grammy-winning music producers, designers, videographers, and other creative freelancers. Despite being extremely talented at their craft, they have never been taught how to consistently find and close clients. The decision you help them make on a sales call can completely change their career. Not only will you be affecting the lives and businesses of the people you enroll in our consulting program, but you'll also be impacting each and every client they work with as well. If you're a high performer who's been stuck in a toxic sales team and you want to help create a healthy, thriving sales culture, you'll love being able to help us build out the sales team from the ground up and set the right culture from day one. If you've spent years selling products you don't believe in , this is an opportunity to use your talent on something that genuinely helps people build better businesses and lives. If you are tired of being one of dozens of closers with no influence over anything upstream, you will have direct access to the founder and a real voice in how we improve the company. If you want the upside of commission without gambling your income while learning a completely new company, offer, and lead source, that is exactly why we created the guaranteed minimum. Where you'll work Our entire company operates remotely, with a diverse team spread across the United States, Portugal, England, Romania, Israel, and South Korea. You can work from home, a quiet coworking space, or anywhere else with reliable internet and a professional place to take calls. You must be available to take calls during U.S. business hours and have a setup where prospects will not hear dogs barking, roommates yelling, or a coffee grinder running during their enrollment call. What We Do At 6 Figure Creative (And Why We Do It) 6 Figure Creative is a business consultancy for creative freelancers who are stuck relying on referrals, word of mouth, inconsistent content, or last-minute desperate outreach to find clients. Our mission is to help creatives earn more without selling their souls. Our 90-Day Client Acquisition Consulting Sprint helps freelancers build and implement a repeatable system for attracting and closing clients. We believe that the education system is fundamentally broken. Universities will gladly charge their students $100k+ for a creative degree and never teach them the most important skills and strategies for how to actually get an ROI from their investment. The consulting program you'll be selling exists to help the best creatives in the world change the trajectory of their careers (and lives) by learning the skills universities failed to teach them. It takes more than passion to succeed, and everything we do is built around giving our clients the strategies, tools, processes, guidance, consulting, and accountability they need to have successful businesses. If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, apply below. I look forward to working with you! - Brian Hood, Founder P.S. Here's the job scorecard for this role P.P.S. Here's a short video about what it's like to work here Requirements Required Qualifications: You have 3+ years of high-performance phone or Zoom sales experience, ideally selling coaching, consulting, agency services, education, or another high-ticket offer You have personally closed at least $3 million in revenue, including at least $1 million during a single 12-month period You have experience selling offers in or near the $6,000 to $10,000 range You have documented experience closing cold or lukewarm prospects generated through direct-response Meta or YouTube ads You can provide real numbers from previous roles, including call volume, sales volume, close rate, offer price, lead source, and revenue closed You have maintained a 30% or greater close rate over a meaningful sample of held sales calls and can clearly explain how that close rate was calculated You are willing to complete a live sales roleplay and provide professional references who can verify your performance You consistently maintain accurate CRM records, call notes, follow-up, and next steps without needing to be chased Availability and Logistics You can keep at least 35 bookable sales-call slots open each week. You can live anywhere, but you must reliably work during agreed U.S. business hours and communicate fluently and professionally in English. Preferred Qualifications: You understand digital marketing and client acquisition You have sold business coaching or consulting offers to entrepreneurs, freelancers, or small-business owners You have experience working with creative professionals You have experience with short sales cycles involving one or two calls You have worked inside a founder-led company You enjoy improving scripts, sales systems, and the performance of the people around you You are interested in helping build a high-performing sales team as the company grows Benefits $100,000 guaranteed minimum compensation Uncapped commissions 100% remote work Flexible time off Monthly house-cleaning service $1,000 annual home-office upgrade allowance Direct access to the founder A real opportunity to influence the offer and sales process Compensation You will receive the greater of your guaranteed monthly compensation or the commissions you earn that month. Guaranteed minimum $100,000 annually Paid monthly at $8,333.33 Nonrecoverable No negative balance No repayment obligation Standard commissions $850 for every paid-in-full enrollment 10% of cash collected from clients using a two-payment or three-payment plan No cap on commissions At our current payment mix: Approximately 20 sales per month should produce roughly $185,000 or more in annual compensation Approximately 25 sales per month should produce roughly $235,000 or more A top-performer can exceed $250,000 Actual compensation depends on the number of clients enrolled, the mix of paid-in-full and payment-plan clients, and when payment-plan installments are collected. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/6-figure-creative-remote-high-ticket-closer

Once a prospect lands on your calendar, you own that opportunity from preparation through follow-up and final decision.

Your main responsibilities include:

1: Enrollment calls:

You will spend most of your time helping prospects determine whether our consulting sprint is right for them.

If they truly need our help and are a strong fit, you should see it as your responsibility to help them make the decision instead of allowing fear, uncertainty, or a weak objection to send them back to the same situation they wanted to escape.

That means you will:

  • Review every application before the call
  • Diagnose the real issues inside the prospect's business
  • Understand their goals, urgency, financial situation, and readiness
  • Determine whether they are a strong fit for our consulting sprint
  • Clearly explain our process, expectations, and investment
  • Make a direct recommendation when you believe they should enroll
  • Handle objections with empathy, patience, and confidence
  • Disqualify prospects who are not a good fit
  • Avoid enrolling obvious red-flag or high-risk clients just to hit a sales number

2: CRM and lead ownership

You will take complete ownership of every lead assigned to you inside GoHighLevel.

No qualified opportunity should be lost because of weak follow-up, incomplete notes, or an unclear next step.

That means you will:

  • Keep every opportunity stage accurate
  • Complete detailed notes after every call
  • Record the outcome and next step for every prospect
  • Complete all required follow-up on time
  • Reschedule qualified prospects who miss their calls
  • Work no-shows through our recovery process
  • Continue following up until the prospect enrolls, declines, or is formally closed out
  • Keep your sales data accurate enough that we never have to guess what is happening inside your pipeline

3: Call review and improvement

Every enrollment call is recorded.

You should already be excellent at sales when you join us. Call review here is about sharpening strong performance, identifying patterns, testing better approaches, and turning individual wins into improvements the entire sales team can use.

You will regularly review your own calls, participate in team call reviews and roleplay, and bring useful insights from your conversations back to the rest of the company.

That means you will:

  • Review your own calls and identify specific areas to improve
  • Bring useful wins, losses, and difficult calls to team call reviews
  • Give and receive direct, thoughtful feedback
  • Test new approaches instead of relying on the same script forever
  • Apply what we learn to future calls
  • Help identify patterns in objections, lead quality, messaging, and offer positioning
  • Share what is working so the entire sales team improves alongside you

4: Improve the company's sales process

You will work closely with me, the founder, to continuously improve our offer, messaging, scripts, follow-up, and overall sales process.

You are talking directly to the market every day. That makes your feedback extremely valuable.

You will help us:

  • Identify recurring objections and concerns
  • Find weaknesses in our messaging or offer
  • Improve our enrollment call structure
  • Improve email and text follow-up
  • Reduce the time between the first call and the final decision
  • Share useful insights with our marketing and consulting teams
  • Build a stronger sales system for everyone who joins after you

What Success In This Role Looks Like

We are hiring someone who can raise the bar, not just hit the current one.

Within six months, the expectation is that you are handling approximately 70 to 80 completed sales calls per month and maintaining a 30% or greater close rate.

A 35% or greater close rate would be exceptional.

We expect a fast ramp:

  • 9 or more new clients in your first full production month
  • 12 or more in your second full production month
  • 15 or more in your third full production month

Your first-year target is at least 225 new clients, with 250 or more as the goal.

Who you'll work with

You will report directly to me (Brian Hood), the founder and person writing this job description.

You will also work alongside a veteran closer who has been with the company for 3+ years.

We are not a 40-person boiler room where you are handed a script, dropped into a Slack channel, and treated like rep number 37.

You will have direct access to the person who can actually change the offer, marketing, script, follow-up process, or sales system when something is not working.

See what you'd be selling

This role is easier to evaluate when you can see the actual offer and the proof behind it.

  • Review the Clients By Design program overview
  • See what clients have produced from their paid-ad campaigns

Why apply for this job?

If you're an experienced sales rep who wants to use your skills to help transform the lives of creatives who run freelance businesses, this job might be the perfect fit for you.

Our clients include Grammy-winning music producers, designers, videographers, and other creative freelancers.

Despite being extremely talented at their craft, they have never been taught how to consistently find and close clients.

The decision you help them make on a sales call can completely change their career.

Not only will you be affecting the lives and businesses of the people you enroll in our consulting program, but you'll also be impacting each and every client they work with as well.

If you're a high performer who's been stuck in a toxic sales team and you want to help create a healthy, thriving sales culture, you'll love being able to help us build out the sales team from the ground up and set the right culture from day one.

If you've spent years selling products you don't believe in, this is an opportunity to use your talent on something that genuinely helps people build better businesses and lives.

If you are tired of being one of dozens of closers with no influence over anything upstream, you will have direct access to the founder and a real voice in how we improve the company.

If you want the upside of commission without gambling your income while learning a completely new company, offer, and lead source, that is exactly why we created the guaranteed minimum.

Our entire company operates remotely, with a diverse team spread across the United States, Portugal, England, Romania, Israel, and South Korea.

You can work from home, a quiet coworking space, or anywhere else with reliable internet and a professional place to take calls.

You must be available to take calls during U.S. business hours and have a setup where prospects will not hear dogs barking, roommates yelling, or a coffee grinder running during their enrollment call.

What We Do At 6 Figure Creative (And Why We Do It)

6 Figure Creative is a business consultancy for creative freelancers who are stuck relying on referrals, word of mouth, inconsistent content, or last-minute desperate outreach to find clients.

Our mission is to help creatives earn more without selling their souls.

Our 90-Day Client Acquisition Consulting Sprint helps freelancers build and implement a repeatable system for attracting and closing clients.

We believe that the education system is fundamentally broken. Universities will gladly charge their students $100k+ for a creative degree and never teach them the most important skills and strategies for how to actually get an ROI from their investment.

The consulting program you'll be selling exists to help the best creatives in the world change the trajectory of their careers (and lives) by learning the skills universities failed to teach them.

It takes more than passion to succeed, and everything we do is built around giving our clients the strategies, tools, processes, guidance, consulting, and accountability they need to have successful businesses.

I look forward to working with you!

- Brian Hood, Founder

P.P.S. Here's a short video about what it's like to work here

  • You have personally closed at least $3 million in revenue, including at least $1 million during a single 12-month period
  • You have experience selling offers in or near the $6,000 to $10,000 range
  • You have documented experience closing cold or lukewarm prospects generated through direct-response Meta or YouTube ads
  • You can provide real numbers from previous roles, including call volume, sales volume, close rate, offer price, lead source, and revenue closed

  • You are willing to complete a live sales roleplay and provide professional references who can verify your performance

  • You can keep at least 35 bookable sales-call slots open each week.

  • You understand digital marketing and client acquisition
  • You have sold business coaching or consulting offers to entrepreneurs, freelancers, or small-business owners
  • You have experience working with creative professionals
  • You have experience with short sales cycles involving one or two calls
  • You have worked inside a founder-led company
  • You enjoy improving scripts, sales systems, and the performance of the people around you
  • You are interested in helping build a high-performing sales team as the company grows

  • Uncapped commissions
  • 100% remote work
  • Flexible time off
  • Monthly house-cleaning service
  • $1,000 annual home-office upgrade allowance
  • Direct access to the founder
  • A real opportunity to influence the offer and sales process

You will receive the greater of your guaranteed monthly compensation or the commissions you earn that month.

Guaranteed minimum

  • $100,000 annually
  • Paid monthly at $8,333.33
  • Nonrecoverable
  • No negative balance
  • No repayment obligation

Standard commissions

  • 10% of cash collected from clients using a two-payment or three-payment plan
  • No cap on commissions

At our current payment mix:

  • Approximately 20 sales per month should produce roughly $185,000 or more in annual compensation
  • Approximately 25 sales per month should produce roughly $235,000 or more
  • A top-performer can exceed $250,000

Actual compensation depends on the number of clients enrolled, the mix of paid-in-full and payment-plan clients, and when payment-plan installments are collected.

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote URL: https://retr.app/ Why this role matters now A loan officer's business runs on relationships. Ours runs on making sure RETR never gets in the way of theirs. When something breaks for a customer, a real deal is on the line, and what they need is a person who understands both the product and their business. That person is you. Most support jobs are a treadmill: you answer the question, the question comes back, you answer it again. Here the work compounds. A good answer becomes an article, the article teaches our AI, and the question stops coming. We measure which articles resolve and which fail, so you can watch the queue shrink because of something you wrote. What you'll do • Be the first human a customer talks to, across email, chat, and phone, for individual and enterprise accounts alike • Answer the hard half. Our AI handles the routine questions; what reaches you is the ambiguous, the technical, and the high-stakes • Write and improve the knowledge base articles that make the AI better and the queue smaller. We measure which articles resolve and which fail, and we fix the ones that fail • Build real fluency in mortgage and real estate workflows, deep enough to explain our product in the customer's language rather than ours • Take actions that carry weight: refunds, cancellations, and billing corrections in Stripe • Surface product friction to Engineering with enough evidence that it gets fixed, then tell the customer when it ships • Hand inbound leads to Sales cleanly. Support does not sell, but Support is often the first to touch a future enterprise deal The first 90 days Two things in this job reach customers at scale without a human in between: the knowledge base, which feeds our AI, and our enterprise accounts. A knowledge base article that is 80 percent right makes the AI wrong for everyone who asks. So neither one is handed to you on a calendar date. Both are handed over when you have earned them. Days 1 to 14. Product and customer mastery. Learn what every search does and why a customer would use it. Read every knowledge source we have. Study the queue, open and closed. Start answering emails and chats. Days 15 to 30. Triage with ease. Route what you cannot answer to the right place. Start taking phone calls, which demand faster answers than anything written. Day 30. You can run the inbox alone, handle refunds and cancellations, and walk a customer through troubleshooting without help. You will run a mock demo of the platform with your manager playing the customer. Day 60. You start owning knowledge base articles. If a customer asks something twice, you write it. Day 90. Full coverage, including enterprise, to the white-glove standard those customers expect. The test that matters: your manager can be offline for a week and nothing breaks. We would rather ramp you properly than throw you at enterprise in week three and apologize to a customer for it. The team Two people. You report to our Customer Support Manager. She reports to our COO. That is the org. You will also work directly with Engineering on bugs and escalations, with Customer Enablement on onboarding, and with Sales on inbound leads. We are twelve people. Everyone reaches across. The stack • Support. HubSpot for tickets, SLAs, and reporting. Aircall for phone. Stripe for billing. • AI. An AI agent handling first-line resolution, tuned against a knowledge base you will help own. • Product. The RETR platform: search, lists, exports, alerts, and enterprise account management. What we're looking for • 1 to 3 years in a customer-facing role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company • Genuine patience and real critical thinking. Most of what reaches you will not have an obvious answer • You explain the why behind an issue rather than just the fix, because that is what builds trust • Sharp attention to detail in how you document requests, troubleshooting steps, and interactions, plus the instinct to see a problem before it lands • You would rather fix the root cause than close the ticket • Comfort with support tooling and a willingness to learn new systems quickly • Curiosity about AI as a tool you shape, not a threat you resent. A meaningful part of this job is making the machine better Bonus. Familiarity with the mortgage or real estate industry, or another regulated and technical field. How we operate Three philosophies we run by: • Give more than you get. • Lead with value. • Do the right thing. Five values behind them: Honesty. Integrity. Fairness. Accountability. Excellence. You'll love this job if you already operate this way. If you don't, we're not the right fit for you. “Give more than you get” is the one that shows up most in this job. It is the difference between answering the question a customer asked and answering the question they were actually trying to solve. We may not always be able to go the extra mile, but we can always go the extra inch. What we offer • $52,000 to $58,000 base salary. National band, no geo-adjustment • Fully remote, US-based • Medical Insurance • Dental, vision, life, short-term and long-term disability employer-provided • 401(k) with match: 100% of your first 1% plus 50% of your next 5% • 15 days PTO plus 13 paid holidays, including Christmas Eve and the day after Thanksgiving • $100 weekly meal stipend, $100 monthly wellness stipend • Full home office setup: laptop, monitors, camera, peripherals provided What we don't offer • Big-tech RSUs. We're bootstrapped. No stock grants. • Bureaucracy. We're small and we like it that way. • A ticket queue you disappear into. What you learn from customers reaches the people who build the product, in the same week. • A script to hide behind. Our customers are people building businesses, not numbers in a queue, and we answer them that way. How to apply Send a resume and a short note to jobs@retr.app answering one question: tell us about a question you got asked so many times that you did something about it. What did you change, and did it work? We read every application. If there's a fit, we'll set up a conversation. We're an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. More at retr.app. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/retr-customer-support-specialist

•     Give more than you get.

•     Lead with value.

•     Do the right thing.

“Give more than you get” is the one that shows up most in this job. It is the difference between answering the question a customer asked and answering the question they were actually trying to solve. We may not always be able to go the extra mile, but we can always go the extra inch.

•     Big-tech RSUs. We're bootstrapped. No stock grants.

•     Bureaucracy. We're small and we like it that way.

•     A ticket queue you disappear into. What you learn from customers reaches the people who build the product, in the same week.

•     A script to hide behind. Our customers are people building businesses, not numbers in a queue, and we answer them that way.

How to apply

Send a resume and a short note to jobs@retr.app answering one question: tell us about a question you got asked so many times that you did something about it. What did you change, and did it work?

We read every application. If there's a fit, we'll set up a conversation.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

Overview

Hi, I'm Al Shvarts, Senior Manager, IT, and I'm looking for a part-time Sr. IT Specialist contractor to join our globally distributed IT team as we scale. This is a hands-on role focused on keeping our people productive and our systems secure across a fully remote, SaaS-first environment. You'll execute day-to-day support, improve and automate lifecycle workflows, and contribute to our security and compliance posture through reliable operational follow-through.

This is a great opportunity to get exposure to IT operations at a fast-growing SaaS company, with a clear path to full-time conversion based on performance and business need.

Some of the things you'll do

  • Own tier 1-2 support across hardware, software, SaaS apps, and remote connectivity, with a customer-service-first mindset
  • Execute employee lifecycle workflows (onboarding, offboarding, role changes) and improve assigned steps through automation and process refinement
  • Administer identity and access management: provisioning, SSO, group and role-based access across core systems
  • Maintain day-to-day device fleet health via MDM (device compliance, endpoint protection, patching, configuration)
  • Support SOC 2, ISO, and HIPAA compliance through evidence collection, access review prep, and control adherence
  • Work across our core tools - Okta (or similar), Jira, Notion, Linear - to triage, track, and resolve requests
  • Create and update operational documentation for owned workflows
  • Partner with People, Security, and Engineering on cross-functional projects

About You

  • Self-starter with a customer-service-first mindset, just as focused on user happiness as on policy
  • Automation-minded - you fix it once, then make it self-serve
  • Comfortable moving fast in a still-being-defined environment; you want variety and ownership, not the same day on repeat
  • Clear communicator who documents well and escalates program-level gaps or decisions rather than sitting on them

What we're looking for

  • 3-5 years in IT support, systems administration, or IT operations, ideally at another B2B SaaS or tech company
  • Hands-on experience with MDM solutions (Kandji, Jamf, Intune, or similar)
  • Experience with identity and access management (Okta strongly preferred), SSO, and role-based access - bonus if you've helped build an access framework, not just operated inside one
  • Demonstrated experience building automation to reduce manual IT work (scripting, workflow tools, or provisioning platforms)
  • Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO, or HIPAA activities (access reviews, evidence gathering, control adherence); familiarity with audit tooling is a plus, direct program ownership is not required
  • Comfortable working across multiple ticketing/workflow systems and adapting to new tooling quickly
  • Strong troubleshooting on macOS (Windows a plus)

Interview Plan

  • minute Zoom call with call with Recruiter
  • 30-minute call with Hiring Manager
  • 45-minute Technical Interview with Peer

Logistics

  • Hours: Full-time (30+ hrs/week), PST preferred
  • Rate: $45-$50/hour
  • Location: Remote, US-based
  • Contract: 3-months

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-contract-it-specialist

jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote - US About the Job: LaunchDarkly is hiring a Backend Software Engineer to join our Flag Delivery team. Serving data to our customers is the core of our product and we’re expanding the team to add bandwidth and energy. The team is very senior, and this role is for someone eager to learn and grow as the team balances modernization with resilience and operational improvements. In this role, you’ll build and improve backend services that sit directly on LaunchDarkly’s critical delivery path, partner closely with SDK, Platform, SRE, and Security, and work on real-time production systems at scale. This role is a strong fit for an engineer who is excited by distributed systems, weird production behavior, and learning quickly on a senior team, and who already brings real production instincts, strong debugging judgment, and clear AI fluency in their engineering work. Responsibilities: Build, improve, and operate backend services that power LaunchDarkly’s Flag Delivery systems. Contribute to systems that support streaming and polling delivery models for LaunchDarkly SDKs. Debug production issues, improve service reliability, and help the team maintain strong standards around latency, availability, observability, and operability. Work with technologies and patterns common to modern distributed backend systems, including caching layers, network services, concurrency, failure handling, and cloud infrastructure. Collaborate closely with partner teams including SDK, Platform, SRE, Security, and Enterprise to deliver improvements across the broader platform. Participate in the on-call rotation and take ownership of the systems you help build. Learn the existing architecture deeply and make pragmatic improvements that increase system clarity, performance, and maintainability. Use AI as part of your engineering workflow with sound judgment, including knowing when to use it, how to direct it effectively, and how to verify or reject its output. Reason clearly about code, architecture, and whole-system behavior even when AI is in the loop. About You: You are kind, coachable, and excited to learn from senior engineers. You already use AI regularly in your engineering work and can explain how, when, and why You enjoy understanding how real systems behave in production, not just how they are supposed to work on paper. You are curious about scale, failure, caching, delivery, and operability. You are energized by debugging, tradeoffs, and steadily improving systems over time. You bring real backend or infrastructure ownership, not just feature implementation. You care about writing software that is maintainable, observable, and dependable. Qualifications: 5+ years of backend software engineering experience. Experience building or operating production backend systems. Strong programming skills in Go, Java, Rust, or a similar backend language; today the team primarily uses Go, with some Rust in the broader environment. Clear, existing AI usage in engineering work. Ability to use AI without surrendering technical judgment. Familiarity with distributed systems fundamentals such as caching, concurrency, failure modes, and reliability. Experience debugging production issues and using observability to understand system behavior. Ability to reason clearly about code, architecture, and system behavior. Strong learning orientation and comfort working with senior engineers. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work well across engineering teams. Willingness to participate in on-call and production support. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. *Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas. **Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary. jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

As an Australia Public Sector Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI within the Australian government space, establishing and growing our presence in this strategic market. You'll leverage your consultative sales expertise and deep understanding of the Australian public sector landscape to propel revenue growth while becoming a trusted partner to customers, helping them embed and deploy AI while uncovering its full range of capabilities. In collaboration with GTM, product, and marketing teams, you'll help define our market entry strategy and value proposition for the Australian public sector.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Anthropic's market entry and expansion in the Australian public sector, establishing our presence and building relationships with key stakeholders across government departments and agencies
  • Own the full sales cycle for Australian public sector opportunities, from initial outreach through to successful deployment, with a focus on building long-term strategic partnerships
  • Navigate the unique procurement requirements, security standards, and compliance frameworks specific to Australian government technology adoption
  • Collaborate with policy teams to ensure alignment with Australian government AI strategies and initiatives
  • Design and execute innovative sales strategies tailored to the Australian public sector environment, meeting and exceeding revenue targets while maintaining strong relationships with procurement teams and decision-makers
  • Provide market intelligence and feedback to product teams to ensure our offerings meet Australian public sector requirements and use cases
  • Build and maintain relationships with relevant systems integrators and technology partners in the Australian market
  • Develop and document best practices for Australian public sector engagement, creating playbooks that can scale our presence in the market
  • Serve as a leader within the broader public sector team, sharing insights and collaborating on cross-market opportunities

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 10+ years of enterprise sales experience in the Australian public sector, with a proven track record of driving adoption of emerging technologies
  • Deep understanding of Australian government procurement processes, security requirements, and technology adoption frameworks
  • Security clearances required
  • Demonstrated ability to build and grow new market segments, with potential to develop into a leadership role
  • Strong track record of managing complex sales cycles and securing strategic deals in the public sector
  • Experience navigating multiple stakeholders across government departments, building consensus and providing innovative solutions
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to present confidently to all levels, from technical teams to senior government officials
  • Strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution capabilities
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with global teams
  • A passion for safe and ethical AI development, with the ability to articulate its importance in the public sector con

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

  • Sara Price
  • Alex Tamkin
  • Nina Panickssery
  • Trenton Bricken
  • Logan Graham
  • Jascha Sohl-Dickstein
  • Joe Benton
  • Fabien Roger
  • Samuel Marks
  • Kyle Fish
  • Ethan Perez

  • Are motivated by reducing catastrophic risks from advanced AI systems
  • Have experience with empirical ML research projects
  • Have experience working with large language models
  • Have experience in one of the research areas mentioned above
  • Have a track record of open-source contributions

  • Keri Warr
  • Evyatar Ben Asher
  • Keane Lucas
  • Newton Cheng

  • Strengthening Red Teams: A Modular Scaffold for Control Evaluations: Chloe Loughridge et al., mentored by Jon Kutasov and Joe Benton

  • Have reported CVEs or been awarded bug bounties
  • Have experience with empirical ML research projects
  • Have experience with deep learning frameworks and experiment management

  • Alwin Peng
  • Zygi Straznickas

  • AI agents find $4.6M in blockchain smart contract exploits

Projects in this workstream may include:

  • Building a CPU simulator for accelerator workloads
  • Adding backends for different accelerators on an open source project
  • Building on demand infrastructure for other infrastructure heavy fellows projects 
  • Building complex synthetic data or environment pipelines

Unique candidate criteria

  • Have strong software engineering skills with experience building complex ML systems

  • Enjoy collaborating across research and engineering disciplines
  • Are comfortable working with large-scale distributed systems and high-performance computing (e.g. in trading)
  • Have experience with training, fine-tuning, or evaluating large language models
  • Are adept at analyzing and debugging model training processes

Mentors, research areas, & past projects

Fellows will undergo a project selection & mentor matching process. Potential research areas and mentors include:

  • Ruhua Jiang
  • Kaidi Cao
  • Sunny Duan
  • David Brandfonbrener
  • Colt Steele
  • Dino Distefano
  • Will Williams

Projects in this workstream may include:

  • A research project to better understand generalization
  • Creating RL environments to improve Claude models at capabilities that are within your domain of expertise
  • Building RL environments for safety-related tasks
  • Conducting research and implementing solutions in areas such as RL algorithms

  • Can balance research exploration with engineering rigor and operational reliability
  • Enjoy collaborating across research and engineering disciplines
  • Are comfortable working with large-scale distributed systems and high-performance computing

  • Policy, Security, and Society

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is building Treasury with scale and automation in mind from the start. We're creating modern, well-controlled processes that can grow with the business - supported by strong systems, clear governance, and practical use of AI-enabled tools. We're designing AI-native workflows from day one, with human in the loop, SOX-grade controls built in rather than bolted on.

This role reports to the Treasury Ops Lead and owns the company's global cash and liquidity function. You'll run the daily cash desk - positioning, forecasting, funding, and payments, while building the visibility and liquidity structures (pooling, concentration, repatriation) that let a multi-entity, multi-currency company see and deploy its cash as one balance sheet.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both execution and process building. You should be comfortable running the daily position while designing the cash architecture the company will run on at 10x scale.

Key responsibilities

  • Own daily cash positioning across all entities and currencies, track balances, consolidate activity, and set the daily funding plan
  • Direct cash management operations: wire/ACH execution, cash concentration, sweep structures, and cash pooling activities
  • Build and run the short- and medium-term cash forecast (13-week and beyond), including variance tracking, scenario modeling, and reporting to leadership
  • Identify and implement strategies to optimize working cash balances and minimize idle funds - right cash, right entity, right currency, right time
  • Monitor liquidity risk, counterparty exposure, and concentration limits; escalate before they become issues
  • Build a single global view of cash - consolidate balance and transaction reporting across all banks, entities, and currencies into one source of truth
  • Partner with the Accounting team to design and manage intercompany funding and settlement processes, including cross-border movement, netting, and documentation
  • Streamline cross-border transaction flows and optimize cash repatriation strategies in partnership with Accounting, Tax, and Legal
  • Support pooling / in-house-bank structures as the entity footprint grows
  • Manage bank relationships from the services side including fee analysis, service reviews, wallet allocation, and connectivity - to get the most out of our banking partners
  • Design the "Claudification" layer for cash: identify which workflows to be automated, build the automation, keep humans in the decisions that need judgment
  • Support TMS buy vs build evaluation/implementation with a cash-and-liquidity lens: bank connectivity (SWIFT, APIs, host-to-host), balance/transaction reporting, cash-position and forecast modules
  • Partner with Finance Systems to simplify and automate cash reporting and forecasting
  • Own cash and liquidity data quality - the source of truth that positioning, forecasting, and investment decisions depend on
  • Execute cash processes with strong focus on controls, documentation, segregation of duties, and audit readiness
  • Support development and maintenance of cash management, liquidity, and ST investment policies and procedures
  • Document cash-desk controls for SOX readiness - not as a separate project, but as how the work gets done
  • Partner with Accounting on close activities, cash reporting, and audit requests

Minimum qualifications

  • You currently own the daily cash position. You log into the bank portals or TMS, you run the position, you set the funding plan, you execute the wires. This is a doing role, not a managing role
  • Liquidity-native depth. You came up through the cash desk - positioning, forecasting, pooling, intercompany funding, FX settlement. You think in cash flows and funding needs, not just balances
  • Multi-entity, multi-currency fluency. You've moved money across borders, worked through repatriation constraints, and built (or run) a global pooling or concentration structure
  • Player-coach DNA. You still do the work - run the position, chase the variance, troubleshoot the wire — while building the system so nobody has to do it manually next quarter
  • Hands-on TMS experience. You've worked in a Treasury Management System (Kyriba, GTreasury, Trovata, Quantum, or similar) on the cash/forecasting/connectivity side: configured it, broken it, fixed it
  • SOX in your DNA. You think in audit trails, approval chains, and segregation of duties — not because compliance makes you, but because well-controlled processes are the ones that scale
  • Comfort with ambiguity. There's no playbook here. You'll write it
  • AI-first mindset. Not a prompt engineer - a Treasury person who wants the model handling data so you can focus on decisions

Preferred qualifications

  • 5–8 years in Treasury / cash management, ideally at a growth-stage or scaling company where you saw the cash structure get built, not just inherited
  • Built or run a cash pooling, notional pooling, or in-house-bank structure
  • Cash repatriation experience - worked with Tax on dividends, intercompany loans, or capital returns to move trapped cash
  • Short-term investment / money-market experience within an investment policy
  • Worked with bank APIs, SWIFT reporting, or Treasury aggregators (Trovata, Kyriba, or direct connectivity)
  • Exposure to SOX readiness or IPO prep, even as a contributor
  • CTP certification

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. About the Role

Anthropic is looking for a Partner Enablement leader to own how we enable our cloud partner ecosystem. Claude reaches a significant share of enterprise customers through AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, and the sellers, solution architects, and delivery teams inside those organizations are often the first people a customer talks to about deploying frontier AI. This role makes sure they are ready.

You will translate Anthropic's product and go-to-market strategy into repeatable programs that help cloud partner field teams find, qualify, and win Claude opportunities, and then deliver them well. That means building the enablement infrastructure end to end: onboarding, launch readiness, sales and technical training, certification pathways, co-sell playbooks, and the metrics that tell us whether any of it is working.

The job runs in both directions, and internal enablement is a sizable portion of it. Just as important as readying partner field teams is making sure Anthropic's own GTM organization knows how to work with the hyperscalers: which partnerships we have and what each one actually covers, how co-sell and marketplace mechanics differ across the three providers, when to pull a partner into a deal, and the offering nuances that determine what we can and cannot do through each channel.

This is a build role as much as a run role. Cloud partner enablement at Anthropic is early, so you will be designing the operating model at the same time as you are shipping against a fast launch cadence. You will work closely with Partnerships, Applied AI, Product Marketing, Sales, and each hyperscaler's own partner and enablement organizations.

Responsibilities

You will own the cloud partner enablement strategy across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, defining what "ready" means for each partner motion and building the programs that get partner field teams there. That starts with the co-sell motion: you will build the playbooks that let partner sellers carry Claude into enterprise deals alongside our own team, and you will make sure those assets map to how each hyperscaler's marketplace and co-sell mechanics actually work.

You will design and run scalable enablement programs rather than one-off training. That includes onboarding paths for new cloud partner teams, role-based learning journeys for sellers and a repeatable launch readiness motion so partner teams are current on every new model and capability we ship.

This work runs in both directions. You will also enable Anthropic's own GTM team, making sure sellers and partner-facing staff know which cloud partnerships we have and what each one covers, how co-sell and marketplace mechanics differ across the three providers, when to bring a partner into a deal, and the offering nuances that shape what we can do through each channel. Keeping the field current as those agreements and offerings change is a standing part of the job.

You will build the content and the systems behind it, curating what lives in our partner portal and learning platforms, establishing review and refresh governance so nothing goes stale, and creating enablement assets that hold up in front of technical and commercial audiences alike. You will also partner directly with the enablement and partner development teams inside each cloud provider to land Anthropic content inside their channels, which is how this work reaches scale.

Finally, you will instrument the program. You will define the metrics that connect enablement activity to partner-sourced pipeline, certification attainment, and deal velocity.

  • Deep partner ecosystem knowledge, including a working understanding of how cloud co-sell motions operate in practice, from opportunity registration and marketplace transactions through to joint delivery
  • Direct experience with one or more of AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure, either from inside those organizations or from a partner or ISV working closely alongside them
  • A proven track record building and maintaining enablement programs that scale, ideally from the ground up, with the certification frameworks, learning paths, and program operations to support them
  • Experience enabling internal field teams, not just partners, on how to work with and through a partner ecosystem
  • Strong go-to-market understanding and familiarity with enterprise sales cycles, enough to build content that sellers actually use and to speak credibly with field teams about pipeline and deal progression
  • Excellent program management skills and the ability to run several concurrent workstreams against a fast launch cadence without losing track of quality
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to influence stakeholders you do not manage, across both Anthropic and large partner organizations
  • Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts for mixed commercial and technical audiences
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, and a preference for building durable systems over shipping one-off deliverables

Strong candidates may also have

  • A background in enablement or product marketing
  • Experience launching technical products or platform capabilities through a channel or partner ecosystem
  • Familiarity with LMS and partner portal platforms, and with certification delivery at scale
  • Hands-on familiarity with LLM and AI developer tooling, or a demonstrated ability to get technical quickly in a new domain

Electrical design & engineering
